Method points I will check, so you can meet them up front:

3. Diagnostic: across-seed SD should be near the binomial value sqrt(π(4−π)/1e6) ≈ 0.00164 (half-width ≈ 0.00077); report the comparison in your checks, not in place of the t interval.
4. Since only report/report.md is a delivered path, the report should state where the numbers come from (experiment-repo results file and commit) so a reader can trace them; I will verify by recomputing from your seed-level file and re-running your script.

No concerns with the plan otherwise.
